excerpt: Mutiny started as no-code website personalisation for B2B marketers and now sells an AI sales assistant that builds personalised decks, pages and deal rooms. Free plan; Business $50/month.
content:
Mutiny is a software company for B2B go-to-market teams. It became known for no-code website personalisation: its 2022 funding announcement described a platform that plugs into a company's existing data and website and uses AI to show different versions of the site to different visitors, so marketers could tailor pages to target accounts. Mutiny now describes itself as the sales assistant built for customer-facing work. Its website says sales and marketing teams use it to create on-brand personalised assets, such as decks, interactive landing pages and deal rooms that update with the deal, and to see who viewed them. It offers templates ("blueprints") for prospecting, account-based marketing landing pages, meeting recaps, demo pre-reads, case studies, proposals, business cases and expansion plans, plus Routines that automate recurring work and integrations with tools such as Salesforce, Outreach and Salesloft.

Jaleh Rezaei is Mutiny's co-founder and CEO.

Funding

In April 2022 Mutiny announced a $50 million Series B co-led by Tiger Global and Insight Partners, with earlier investors Sequoia Capital, Cowboy Ventures and Uncork Capital taking part, according to Insight Partners' release and Silicon Legal Strategy, which advised Cowboy Ventures.

Pricing

Mutiny's pricing page lists three plans. Free costs $0 for up to five team members, with five daily AI credits per seat (up to 30 a month), five templates and a mutiny.app domain. Business costs $50 a month for 50 credits, with unlimited team members, templates and integrations, a custom subdomain, visitor intelligence and password-protected assets. Enterprise starts at $40,000 a year and adds SSO, custom credit limits, a Salesforce integration, custom contract terms and a dedicated growth strategist.

Who it suits

Mutiny suits account executives, sales leaders and account-based marketing teams in B2B companies that send many tailored decks and pages. Consumer businesses or teams that rarely send sales collateral may not need it.

We have not tested Mutiny. This page is based on Mutiny's website and pricing page (checked 15 October 2026) and its 2022 funding announcement.
